title: SupaSave
tagline: An app for saving that users can use to lock their cUSD for a specified period of time.
description: SupaSave app allows you to lock your funds for a specified period, ensuring that your savings grow safely and steadily. Whether you're planning for a big purchase, an emergency fund, or just looking to cultivate better saving habits, SupaSave is here to help you reach your goals with peace of mind. Start saving smarter today!
how_its_made:
This projects focuses on the Minipay wallet environment where it is necessary for the app to be very lightweight. Next.js was used  in order to carry out server side rendering. 

Smart contract was written in Solidity (deployed on the Celo network) using Remix and contract was verified. Communications with the smart contract was done using Wagmi on the frontend.
